title: Getting Out of the Bath | Parenting Rewind
description:
The bath was impossible to start and is now impossible to end. A practical pause-and-rewind response for parents.

General parenting education; every child and family is different.
audience_intent: Adults and parents; not directed to children
education_scope: General parenting education only; not personalised therapy, diagnosis, or medical advice.

narration.transcript: The bath was impossible to start and is now impossible to end. Draining the water without warning can make a difficult transition feel abrupt. Before reacting, pause for one breath so the next words can be short, clear, and useful. Give one clear ending cue: Two more pours, then towel; let the child complete the final pour. Predictable endings and limited choices can support transitions without changing the boundary.

source.organization: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
source.title: Steps for Giving Good Directions

claim_limits: The suggested wording is an example, not a guarantee.
Families should adapt expectations to age, development, safety and individual needs.
